title: Latency, in numbers you can hold
blurb: What it costs to reach a value, from a register to another continent, on one scale.
note: These are order-of-magnitude figures for a modern server, not measurements of your machine. The ratios are the point and they have been stable for years even as the absolute numbers moved.
